abstract: This study investigated the molecular mechanisms by which carbon-ion beam irradiation (IR), either alone or in combination with paclitaxel (PTX) or nab-PTX, induces cell death in pancreatic cancer (PC) cells in vitro. Human PC cell lines, PANC-1 and MiaPaCa-2, were treated with carbon-ion beam IR alone or combined with PTX/nab-PTX. Cell viability, caspase-3/7 activity, and the expression of apoptosis-, autophagy-, and angiogenesis-related genes and proteins were analyzed using quantitative real-time RT-PCR (RT-qPCR) and western blotting. Additionally, cell invasion assays were performed. We found that PANC-1 cells were more resistant to carbon-ion beam IR than MiaPaCa-2 cells; however, combination treatment with PTX/nab-PTX enhanced the cytotoxic effects of carbon-ion beam IR (1 Gy). Caspase-3/7 activity was increased by carbon-ion beam IR or PTX alone and was further elevated by the combination treatment. RT-qPCR analysis showed that combined carbon-ion beam IR and PTX decreased the expression of the pro-apoptotic gene Bax while increasing Bcl-2 expression in PANC-1 cells. Furthermore, carbon-ion beam IR, both alone and in combination with PTX, significantly increased the expression of the autophagy-related genes ATG7 and Beclin1 in PANC-1 cells. PTX/nab-PTX alone, or combined with carbon-ion beam IR, enhanced the expression of the apoptosis-associated proteins cleaved PARP and cleaved caspase-3 in both PC cell lines. Combination treatment with carbon-ion beam IR and PTX/nab-PTX effectively suppressed the expression of p-ERK and p-EGFR, but not p-AKT, in PANC-1 cells. In contrast, carbon-ion beam IR (1 Gy) alone, PTX/nab-PTX alone, or the combination treatment effectively inhibited p-ERK, p-EGFR, and p-AKT expression in MiaPaCa-2 cells. Additionally, carbon-ion beam IR combined with PTX significantly inhibited VEGF expression and cell invasion. In conclusion, carbon-ion beam IR in combination with PTX/nab-PTX effectively enhances PC cell death via apoptosis induction and reduces its invasive potential.
key_points_ko: PANC-1 세포는 MiaPaCa-2 세포보다 탄소선 방사선 조사에 더 저항성이 높았으나, PTX/nab-PTX와의 병용 치료로 세포 독성 효과가 향상되었습니다.
카스파세(Caspase-3/7) 활성은 단독 치료에 비해 병용 치료 시 더욱 증가했습니다.
탄소선 방사선 조사와 PTX 병용은 PANC-1 세포에서 자가포식 관련 유전자(ATG7, Beclin1) 발현을 유의하게 증가시켰습니다.
탄소선 방사선 조사와 PTX의 병용은 VEGF 발현과 세포 침윤을 유의하게 억제했습니다.
summary_ko: 본 연구는 체외 실험(in vitro)을 통해 탄소선 방사선 조사 단독 또는 paclitaxel(파클리탁셀, PTX) 및 nab-paclitaxel(나브-파클리탁셀)과의 병용 요법이 췌장암(pancreatic cancer, PC) 세포의 세포 사멸을 유도하는 분자적 기전을 조사했습니다. 사람 췌장암 세포주인 PANC-1과 MiaPaCa-2에 탄소선 방사선 조사와 약물을 단독 또는 병용 처리하여 세포 생존율, 카스파세(caspase-3/7) 활성, 유전자 및 단백질 발현 등을 분석했습니다. 연구 결과, 탄소선 방사선 조사와 PTX/nab-paclitaxel 병용 요법은 세포 사멸 유도를 통해 췌장암 세포의 사멸을 효과적으로 강화하고 침윤성을 감소시키는 것으로 나타났습니다. 초록에 명시되지 않은 임상 환자 대상 수치나 생존기간 결과는 없습니다.
title: Carbon-ion beam irradiation combined with paclitaxel/nab-paclitaxel effectively induces cell death in pancreatic cancer cells
title_ko: 탄소선 방사선 조사와 paclitaxel/nab-paclitaxel 병용 요법은 췌장암 세포의 세포 사멸을 효과적으로 유도합니다
